capabilities.title: Stateless password derivation: generate passwords deterministically from site+login+master
capabilities.sourceEvidence: LessPass core algorithm: PBKDF2 over site+login+counter+master → password, no storage needed
capabilities.reason: Nexus VAULT could offer a stateless passphrase generator using the LessPass algorithm for sites where users don't want to store credentials.

capabilities.title: Zero storage/sync: no database, no cloud sync, passwords reconstructed on demand
capabilities.sourceEvidence: LessPass design: passwords are computed, never stored
capabilities.reason: The zero-storage credential pattern is a useful reference for Nexus API key handling; implement with care around key rotation.

capabilities.title: Open algorithm specification: any client can reproduce the derivation with the same inputs
capabilities.sourceEvidence: LessPass open spec: published algorithm and test vectors
capabilities.reason: A published open algorithm for credential derivation is a good practice to document for any Nexus VAULT crypto feature.
